[/page/1/Text/12] The first year of college is a unique period of development and transition for students and involves a number of challenges. During this period, first year college students experience difficulties related to social integration (Tinto, 1993), blending academic, social, and cultural expectations, and deviating from their families' expectations (Terenzini et al., 1994).
[/page/1/Text/13] Given these challenges, half of college student attrition occurs in the first year (Dursun, 2011), making this time a key target for intervention. Therefore, identifying factors that help first year college students positively adjust and grow and stay in college is a worthy goal for research.
